paite: Huan Samson bel Timnah ah ahohsuk a, Timnah ah Philistiate tanute lak ah numei khat ava mu hi.
heading: Samson Leh Timna Khua A Numei

paite: Ahong paitouh nawn in anu leh apa ahilh hi. "Timnah khua ah, Philistiate tanute lak ah numei khat ka mu a; ka zi ding in hon pisak un," achi hi.

Huchi in anu leh apa'n akiang ah, "Na unaute tanute lak ah hiam, ka mipite lak a hiam numei om het lou hia? Zeksum louh Philistiate lak a zi ding na va zon maimah?" achi uhi. Samson in apa kiang ah, "Hon pisak mai in; ama'n hon lungkimsak mahmah ahi," achi hi.
Himahleh anu leh apa'n, hiai TOUPA a pan ahi chih athei kei uh; ama'n Philistiate tung a phulakna ding hun lemtang zong lah ahi ngal a. Huai lai in Philistiate'n Israelte tung ah vai ahawm uhi.
Huchi in Samson bel anu leh apa toh Timnah ah ahohsuk ua, Timnah a grephuan ava tung uhi. Ngai in, humpinelkai lun lai ana humham hi.
TOUPA Kha atung ah nakpitak in ahong tung hi. Huchi in kelnou balnen bang mai in abalnen maimah hi; bangmah lah atawi ngal kei a. Himahleh athilhih anu leh apa ahilh kei hi.
Ahohsuk a, huai numei ahoupih hi. Ama'n Samson akipaksak mahmah hi.
Anung in va pi ding in ahoh nawn a, humpinelkai luang en ding in ava pial hi. Ngai in, humpinelkai luang ah khuai hon leh azu ana om hi.
Huai ala a, apai nawn a, apai kawm in ane kawmkawm hi. Anu leh pa kiang atungtou a, amau leng apia a, amau leng ane sam uhi. Himahleh huai khuaizu humpinelkai luang a pan alak ahi chih ahilh kei hi.
Huchi in huai numei kiang ah apa ava hohsuk a, huai ah Samson in ankuang alui hi. Huai ahihleh tangvalte hihdan ahi him hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, amah amuhtak un, akiang a om ding in mi sawmthum api uhi.
Samson in akiang uah, "Tu in thuhaksa hon dong ning e. Ankuanglui ni, ni sagih sung a na hon hilhchet theih ua, na theihkhiak theih uleh puanmalngat silh sawmthum ka hon pe ding.

Himahleh na hon hilhchet theih kei uleh, puanmalngat silh sawmthum leh kikhenna puan sawmthum na hon piak ding uh ahi,” achi hi. Amau akiang ah, "Na thuhaksa gen dih ve le, ka na ngaikhe ding uh," achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Netu a pan nek ding hong pawt, hattak a pan thil khumtak hong pawt," achi hi.

Ni thum sung in huai thuhaksa ahilhchian thei kei uh. Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani sagih ni in Samson zi kiang ah, "Ka kiang ua hiai thuhaksa hilhchetna puangkhe ding in na pasal kun in. Huchi lou in zaw nang leh na pa inkote ka hon hal ding uh. Ka neihsa uh la dia hon sam na hi kei maw?" achi uhi.

Huchi in Samson zi ama ah akap a, "N'on it kei a, na hon ho zaw ve. Ka chite lah thuhaksa na dong ngal a, kei na hon hilhchian kei," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, ka nu leh pa leng ka hilh kei a; nang ka hon hilh dia hia?" achi hi.
A-ankuanglui uh, ni sagih sung teng ama ah akapkap hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani sagih ni in anget ngutngut ziak in ahilh khongkhong hi. Ama'n thuhaksa hilhchetna achipihte ava hilhta hi.

Ani sagih ni, nitum ma in huai khua a mite'n akiang ah, "Khuaizu sang a khumzaw bang ahia? Humpinelkai sang a hatzaw bang ahia?" achi uhi. Ama'n akiang uah, "Ka bawngla in lei let kei le uchin zaw, ka thuhaksa theikhe lou ding hi ve uchin," achi hi.

TOUPA Kha atung ah nakpitak in ahong tung a, Ashkelon ah ahohsuk hi. Mi sawmthum ava that a, apuansilhte uh ahawksak a, kikhenna puante thuhaksa hilhchiante apia hi. Huchi in aheh mahmah a, apa inn ah apaitou hi.
Himahleh Samson zi pen akitenna ua theihpih a pang Samson lawmpa kiang ah zi ding in piak in a-om hi.
